events.title: Maker Mondays - learn about 3D printing, laser cutting, electronics and more!
events.description: A recurring open session at Brisbane Makerspace where participants can learn about and experiment with various maker technologies like 3D printing, laser cutting, and electronics, fostering a community of creative problem-solvers.

events.title: "Site, Non Site, Place" - d harding Exhibition
events.description: An exhibition by artist d harding at Milani Gallery in West End, presenting works under the theme 'Site, Non Site, Place'. The gallery is open Wednesday to Saturday, 11 AM to 5 PM.

events.title: Teacher Librarian Book Chat
events.description: A book chat specifically for teacher librarians, offering a community space for discussion and sharing insights on books and literary topics at the Quick Brown Fox Bookshop.

events.title: Open Art Space @ Acacia Ridge
events.description: A casual open art space at Acacia Ridge, hosted by Communify Qld, providing a welcoming environment for community members to engage in creative expression and artistic activities.

events.title: Valley Mens group
events.description: A community men's group facilitated by Uncle Tiger and Andrew Cummins, providing a social and supportive environment for men at the New Farm Neighbourhood Centre.

events.title: Le Festival 2026 (Brisbane French Festival)
events.description: Experience French culture, food, and entertainment at Le Festival, Brisbane's annual French Festival held at Roma Street Parklands. Offers free entry with various workshops and activities available at a cost.

events.title: West End Street Art Festival
events.description: A vibrant festival celebrating street art in West End, featuring local artists, installations, and opportunities for workshops and guided tours. Free to attend with optional paid activities.

events.title: DANZ Awards (popup bookshop support)
events.source: Quick Brown Fox Bookshop (supporting ASLA DANZ Children's Book Awards)
events.description: Quick Brown Fox Bookshop hosts a popup supporting the ASLA DANZ Children's Book Awards at UQ, offering a chance to browse and purchase books related to the awards.

events.title: Heartfulness Meditation
events.description: A free Heartfulness meditation session held at Paddington Hall, offering a grounded and community-focused approach to meditation, welcoming walk-ins and bookings.

events.title: James St Food & Wine Trail
events.description: A popular food and wine trail where James Street closes for a day, allowing visitors to explore various culinary offerings, taste samples, and enjoy the precinct's atmosphere. Free entry with options for paid workshops or food.

events.title: Incognito Art Show
events.datetime: Tue 21 Jul – Sun 26 Jul (Sale Sat 25 & Sun 26 Jul)
events.description: Australia's largest and most inclusive art show, featuring hundreds of anonymous A5 original artworks for sale at $100 each. Browsing is free, with the main sale days on Saturday and Sunday.
